reason: The filing is an annual results presentation (webinar slides) from Rubis dated March 23, 2026. It contains extensive operational and financial information including geographic distribution, business segments (fuel distribution, LPG, bitumen, renewable energy), 2025 results, and 2026 guidance. However, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures are disclosed anywhere in the document. The presentation focuses on operational metrics (volumes, margins, EBITDA), market positioning (Top 3 in most markets), growth trends, and financial performance, but does not quantify the total market size or TAM for any of its business segments. The company describes market characteristics (growth, fragmentation, electrification) but provides no numerical TAM estimates.
